authority.defaultMovementAuthority: authored local legacy lanes until a later M8 activation task explicitly flips the default

hardInvariants: route geometry is compiler-node-owned directed lanes plus activation-safe connectors only
macro graph centres never become local driving coordinates
stable tokenId and materialization slot survive visible route stage changes
normal crossing release is protected; forced hijack/layer/teardown exits remain legal
controlled and multi-agent route activation stay opt-in until an explicit later M8 default-activation gate passes
legacy local behavior and steering never overwrite routeActive x/y
junction conflict handling may delay connector entry but must not invent movement geometry
reservation ownership must be deterministic and released on exit/forced teardown
cars already inside a connector normally clear it instead of voluntarily stopping mid-junction
stale reservations must expire/recover so a vanished token cannot deadlock the junction forever
no traffic-light simulator is introduced unless authored city data explicitly owns signals
MacroTrafficRouteContinuityPolicy and TrafficIntentDrivingPolicy are not re-enabled wholesale

m6ControlledActivation.head: b23dfc0eb1eb07ad3fd85fe89399c7fb5e40c5c0
m6ControlledActivation.contract: controlled straight/right/left production crossings are default-off, preserve fixed pool and stable token/slot, report zero teleports, survive camera movement during connector crossing, and leave default laneAuthority authored-local-lanes

m7JunctionReservation.head: dcb08288ea797e7016bcdb3858299a85549a7259
m7JunctionReservation.contract: conflicting compiler-route tokens reserve before connector entry, wait on the incoming lane, normally clear once inside, release on exit/forced controlled stop, recover stale ownership deterministically, preserve fixed pool/identity and keep default civilian authority on authored local lanes

m8MultiAgentRuntime.head: 9173732803b2b92b28cf26a784e2382169eacc63
m8MultiAgentRuntime.contract: deterministic macro-population provenance seeds stable multi-agent compiler-route tokens; local progression uses compiler lanes/connectors only, conflicting agents share M7 reservations, routeActive pose is guarded from legacy behavior/steering, teardown releases reservations, fixed pool semantics remain intact, macro flows are not mutated and production default traffic remains authored-local-lanes

nextTask.goal: Exercise the complete M8.1 multi-agent runtime against production browser data under an explicit opt-in soak before any default activation or macro-accounting migration.
actions: Add a dedicated production-browser scenario that asserts normal startup is still authored-local-lanes and the M8 runtime is disabled before explicit activation.

Explicitly start the M8 multi-agent runtime only inside the test scenario, capture baseline macro flows, pool identity/size and stable token IDs, then advance it for a bounded soak through its public policy API.

Track visible route positions across the soak and reject coordinate teleports, non-compiler route stages and illegal road-surface exits using existing compiler/local-topology authority wherever possible.

Exercise reservation/yield telemetry under production data and require no stale/deadlocked ownership after stop/teardown; do not invent traffic lights or world-space fallback steering if production timing does not naturally create a conflict.
Move/follow the camera during the opt-in soak and verify route-active assignments retain stable token/slot identity without growing the materialization pool.
Verify legacy behavior/steering guards stay installed only while M8 is explicitly enabled and cannot overwrite routeActive x/y.
Assert live MacroTrafficPoliceSystem trafficFlows are unchanged by the M8.2 soak; compatibility projection remains output-only.
Stop the M8 runtime at scenario end and prove legacy authored-local traffic authority is restored cleanly.
Keep production default activation unchanged in this task; M8.2 is evidence only.
acceptance: normal browser startup reports multiAgentRouteRuntime.enabled false and laneAuthority authored-local-lanes
explicit M8 activation conserves production macro population with seeded plus explicit unseeded records
stable route token and materialization slot identity survive the bounded production soak
no visible route teleport or compiler-geometry authority violation is observed
route reservation state remains bounded and is empty after stop/teardown
legacy behavior/steering cannot overwrite routeActive x/y while enabled
macro trafficFlows/phases/counts remain unchanged during the soak
stopping M8 restores authored-local-lanes behavior cleanly
focused browser evidence and full CI are green
doNotAdvanceIf: the browser scenario requires enabling M8 by default outside the test
macro centres/phases become ongoing local coordinates
route tokens teleport or leave compiler-authorized road geometry
pool grows or stable assignments churn to preserve continuity
live macro traffic state is mutated by the opt-in soak
focused or full CI is red
